transient.label: edge-tts returned no audio (Microsoft voice service hiccup)

transient.pattern: ZeroGPU|GPU quota|exceeded your GPU|queue is full|Queue (?:is )?full|Space is (?:sleeping|building|paused|starting)|space is in error|gradio_client[\s\S]{0,200}(?:AppError|QueueError|TooManyRequests)|huggingface\.co[\s\S]{0,200}(?:429|503)
transient.label: Hugging Face quota or queue

transient.pattern: HTTP Error 5\d\d|\b5(?:00|02|03|04|20|22|24)\b[^\n]{0,60}(?:Server Error|Bad Gateway|Service Unavailable|Gateway Time-?out)|Bad Gateway|Service Unavailable|Gateway Time-?out|upstream connect error|status(?:_code|code)?[ =:]+5\d\d\b|FUNCTION_INVOCATION_TIMEOUT
transient.label: a server outage (5xx)

transient.pattern: Failed to fetch https?://\S*(?:ubuntu|azure|microsoft|launchpad)|Hash Sum mismatch|Mirror sync in progress|Could not get lock /var/lib|Unable to fetch some archives|Temporary failure resolving
transient.label: the Ubuntu package mirror

transient.pattern: npm ERR! (?:network|code E(?:TIMEDOUT|CONNRESET|AI_AGAIN|NOTFOUND|50\d))|npm error (?:network|code E(?:TIMEDOUT|CONNRESET|AI_AGAIN))|ERR_SOCKET_TIMEOUT|ReadTimeoutError|Could not fetch URL https://pypi|pip\._vendor[\s\S]{0,200}(?:ReadTimeout|ProtocolError)
transient.label: the npm / pip download servers

transient.pattern: ConnectionResetError|ConnectionError|ConnectTimeout|ReadTimeout|Read timed out|Connection timed out|ETIMEDOUT|ECONNRESET|ECONNREFUSED|EAI_AGAIN|getaddrinfo|Temporary failure in name resolution|Name or service not known|fetch failed|socket hang up|Connection reset by peer|RemoteDisconnected|IncompleteRead|ServerDisconnectedError|ClientConnectorError|SSL: (?:UNEXPECTED_EOF|DECRYPTION_FAILED)|curl: \((?:6|7|28|35|52|56)\)
transient.label: a network blip

transient.pattern: The runner has received a shutdown signal|lost communication with the server|hosted runner encountered an error|Received request to deprovision|The operation was canceled|exceeded the maximum execution time|has timed out after
transient.label: the GitHub runner (stopped or timed out)

transient.pattern: failed to push some refs[\s\S]{0,300}(?:fetch first|non-fast-forward|rejected)|cannot lock ref|Updates were rejected because the remote contains work
transient.label: two runs pushed at the same time

code.pattern: \b(?:TypeError|ReferenceError|SyntaxError|RangeError): [^\n]*\n\s+at |Cannot find module|ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND|is not a function|Cannot read propert(?:y|ies) of (?:undefined|null)|error TS\d+:
code.label: JavaScript / TypeScript error

code.pattern: command not found|can't open file|No such file or directory|jq: error|syntax error near unexpected token|unbound variable
code.label: script / workflow error

code.pattern: remotion[\s\S]{0,300}(?:Error:|error:)|Composition .* not found|delayRender\(\) .* was called but not cleared
code.label: render (Remotion) error
